input.reply:
Thanks for the report and the StackBlitz repro. I searched existing issues for the error text (`Invalid regular expression ... Stack overflow`) and the regex source, and found no earlier matching report. The only regex-related issues were unrelated (#5220, #848). I also grepped `packages/` for the regex string and found nothing, so it isn't coming from Vitest itself.

The error is a V8 stack overflow raised while compiling the RegExp. That fits your note that adding a `console.log` makes it disappear, because the failure seems to depend on stack depth at that moment. Since it started in 4.0.11, a change in how modules are loaded or executed (deeper call stacks) is a plausible cause, but I haven't confirmed that.

Could you bisect between 4.0.10 and 4.0.11 and tell us whether the failure also happens with a different `pool` (`forks`, `threads`, `vmThreads`)? That will help narrow it down. I can't promise a fix or a timeline.
